blocks.text: Hypothesis testing durust faisle karne ke liye kai aham concepts use karti hai. Har concept ka testing mein apna kaam hai. Inhein samajhne se uljhan nahi hoti, aur yahi batate hain ke hypothesis accept ho ya reject. Yeh concepts mil kar use hote hain aur data analysis mein lagaye jate hain. Inhein sahi samajhna durusti barhata hai, is liye inhein seekhna zaroori hai.
